premise: isa-ordinary-rule:<digest of this file + the condition table + the split table>; without it a derived-ordinary row's table-sourced kinds are unobserved

documents.APM1: AMD64 Architecture Programmer's Manual, Vol. 1 (application programming): long-mode required features
documents.PSABI: System V x86-64 psABI, low-level system information: the x86-64 baseline (CMOV, CX8, FPU, FXSR, MMX, OSFXSR, SCE, SSE, SSE2)
documents.SDM1: Intel SDM Vol. 1 (basic architecture): x87 / MMX / SSE environment chapters
documents.SDM2: Intel SDM Vol. 2 (instruction set reference): exception classes (2.4 / 2.5) and instruction entries
documents.SDM3: Intel SDM Vol. 3 (system programming): CR0 / CR4

base_isa_sets.I86: general-purpose base (APM1: every long-mode processor; forms invalid in 64-bit mode never decode)
base_isa_sets.I286REAL: general-purpose base (APM1); its system forms are SYSTEM-category or cited
base_isa_sets.I286PROTECTED: general-purpose base (APM1); its system forms are SYSTEM-category or cited
base_isa_sets.I486REAL: general-purpose base (APM1): BSWAP, CMPXCHG, XADD; CPUID / INVD / WBINVD are cited
base_isa_sets.PENTIUMREAL: CMPXCHG8B (CX8, PSABI baseline); RDMSR / WRMSR / RDTSC / RSM are cited or ring0
base_isa_sets.PPRO: P6 base forms (APM1); UD2 / RDPMC / SYSENTER / SYSEXIT are cited
base_isa_sets.SSE2MMX: SSE2 forms on MMX registers (PADDQ / PSUBQ / PMULUDQ mm): hardware SSE2 (PSABI baseline); class mmx, no OSFXSR

base_isa_sets_zydis: same names as base_isa_sets (Zydis 4.1.1 uses XED's ISA-set vocabulary; checked by the tests)
outside_base: SSE3 / SSE3X87 / MONITOR, CLFSH, CMPXCHG16B, LAHF, PREFETCH_NOP / 3DNOW_PREFETCH, PAUSE (cited split), RDPMC, SEP, FAT_NOP (cited NOP), PPRO_UD0_LONG (cited UD0): never derived-ordinary

system_flags.note: DF is data input, not a system flag (the engine's DF premise)

cite.entry: exception class: none beyond data-dependent faults

mmx.note: MMX-register forms, including SSE / SSE2 integer instructions on MMX registers (PAVGB mm, PMULHUW mm, PADDQ mm ...): no CR4.OSFXSR dependence

data_faults: unmasked SIMD FP exception (#XM, or #UD when CR4.OSXMMEXCPT=0)

state_dependent: pending unmasked x87 exception (#MF), MMX register forms only
effects: x87-to-MMX transition, MMX register forms only

cite.entry: exception classes MMX_FP / MMX_FP_16ALIGN; forms mixing XMM and MMX registers (CVTPI2PS, MOVQ2DQ ...)

mmx_sse.note: forms with an SSE floating-point exception class or both XMM and MMX register operands

effects: AMD, OSFXSR=1, CPL=0, 64-bit, EFER.FFXSR=1: XMM0-15 skipped, MXCSR and x87 saved (F5)

f5.intel: XMM / MXCSR saved or not: implementation-dependent (UNKNOWN)

f5.amd: XMM0-15 skipped, MXCSR and x87 saved

f6.note: the processor's supported MXCSR bits, written when XMM / MXCSR are saved

effects: AMD, OSFXSR=1, CPL=0, 64-bit, EFER.FFXSR=1: XMM0-15 skipped, MXCSR and x87 restored (F5)

f5.intel: XMM / MXCSR restored or not: implementation-dependent (UNKNOWN)

f5.amd: XMM0-15 skipped, MXCSR and x87 restored

data_faults: MXCSR reserved bits #GP (on the paths that load MXCSR)

effects: x87 tag word set to all empty (no x87-to-MMX transition)

BSWAP.reason: the 16-bit form leaves the destination undefined (cited BSWAP16; r2 A2)

SHLD.reason: 16-bit form: destination undefined for counts above 16 (cited SHLD16)

SHRD.reason: 16-bit form: destination undefined for counts above 16 (cited SHRD16)

flag_meanings.simd_fp_exceptions: the form may raise SIMD FP exceptions
flag_meanings.mxcsr_inputs: MXCSR fields that are inputs: RC (rounding control), DAZ (denormal inputs as zero), FTZ (tiny results flushed)
flag_meanings.writes_mxcsr_status: MXCSR status bits are written even when the exceptions are masked
flag_meanings.explicit_mmx_operand: an explicit MMX register operand (x87-to-MMX transition, pending #MF check)
flag_meanings.alignment: a legacy-SSE memory operand that may require 16-byte alignment (data-dependent)
flag_meanings.masked_write: the memory write depends on a data mask (F7 / memory evidence: conditional)

an int64 may round to a double

mxcsr_cite.entry: the conversion / arithmetic entries (SIMD Floating-Point Exceptions; MXCSR usage)

iced_operand_conventions.note: iced lists implicit accumulator / count / string registers as explicit operands; measured on ntdll (1,822 of 128,310 forms). An iced signature that differs from the entry's is accepted only for these encodings and exactly these signature pairs; anything else fails test A.

pairs.reason: AL / AX / EAX / RAX accumulator immediate forms
STOS / LODS / SCAS with the accumulator

MASKMOVDQU.reason: writes only the bytes whose mask byte has bit 7 set (mask 0: no write); the decoders report an unconditional write

MASKMOVQ.reason: as MASKMOVDQU (not in the allowlist today: MMX_NOFP2)
